messages:
jessica-release: FYI I uploaded the airgap bundle for Private v1.4.2 to the artifacts bucket. Need sign-off on pinning this for the next change window (Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC).

jessica-release: artifacts -> s3://redwood-releases/private/v1.4.2/redwood-airgap-1.4.2.tgz (sha256: 0f3a8b...c1d2)

deploy-bot: release created: private-v1.4.2 by jessica-release. Release notes: "installer fixes, registry auth improvements, kv-cache correctness for onprem setups". Linked PR: https://git.internal/redwood/release/412

tom-eng-infra: quick checklist — container images built & signed? 2GB tarball size ok for some customers?

jessica-release: images built, signed with cosign, and included. Size is 2.0GB compressed. We also produced a minimal delta bundle (120MB) for customers on v1.4.1 -> v1.4.2.

sarah-devex: Verified installer smoke on a fresh VPC test cluster (k8s 1.26). `./installer apply --bundle redwood-airgap-1.4.2.tgz --verify-signature` succeeded.

nilesh-ops: Noted one migration: `db: add_cluster_tags` — migration script included, dry-run passed on our staging db. We should pin the DB migration version in release notes.

emily-ps: Customer communications ready; release notes drafted. Callout: customers using HSM/KMS need to re-run `kms-sync` after upgrade.

zach-sre: Are there any new default ports or firewall rules? Onprem folks always trip up on that.

jessica-release: No new ports. We kept same service ports. Just a note: we added an optional metrics exporter on 9100 if enabled. Will call out in the docs.

tom-eng-infra: +1 to pinning this for Thu change window. Also propose we pin image tags in the installer manifest to `redwood/private:v1.4.2` (no :latest).

jessica-release: Agreed — we'll pin. Also plan the rollback path: bundle v1.4.1 is kept in the bucket and manifest has `rollback-script.sh` which runs the safe DB downgrade check and restores previous images.

deploy-bot: deploy-plan created for private-v1.4.2: change_window=2025-03-13T02:00:00Z..2025-03-13T04:00:00Z, approvers=[tom-eng-infra, nilesh-ops, emily-ps].

nilesh-ops: I've run the canary on two lab clusters. CPU transient spike during migration but within SLOs. Recommend a staged rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%).
